functional_flow: School setup and low-volume definitions
handling: Version-pin roles/policies/group identifiers in school settings; no per-action role table.

functional_flow: Years, reporting periods and assessment points
handling: Typed period rows; freeze exact selected reporting-period IDs.

functional_flow: Roster, staff responsibility and attendance
handling: Separate assignment kinds and attendance fields; absent/unknown participant is reviewable work.

functional_flow: Activity revisions and concurrent edits
handling: Stable root; current-approved versus latest proposal; base-version conflict checks.

functional_flow: Multiple assessment stages and early end
handling: Stage parent validates; preserve stage/form snapshots and explicit future-stage treatment.

functional_flow: Deadline extensions and late work
handling: Conflict B139/B143 remains a policy choice. Current and at-submission comparisons remain reproducible.

functional_flow: Question definitions and form publication
handling: Versioned school bank/block settings and immutable question/form expansions; definition and answer imports remain separate.

functional_flow: Peer invites and explicit reviewer/subject task
handling: Code issue/redemption is traceable; explicit task exists before any peer response is accepted; expiry/eligibility open.

functional_flow: Staged imports, correction and repeated source
handling: Batch parent plus child row work items; immutable original input, expected version, resolved ID and explicit commit outcome.

functional_flow: Certificates, school marks and manual feedback
handling: Wide typed source columns; grade/mark/award separate from official level. Proposed academic contract stays inactive until defined.

functional_flow: Media library and three separate permission dimensions
handling: Per-student media link plus visibility/staff scope/assessment-use decisions; one asset remains one file.

functional_flow: Captions versus generic machine scene description
handling: Human caption column; unconfirmed machine output per run. No label-assisted action recognition or automatic behavioural proof.

functional_flow: Faces, transcripts and speaker correction
handling: Stable region/segment identity; candidates per run; human decisions versioned; unknown people need no guest catalogue.

functional_flow: Proof registration and target-specific inclusion
handling: Accepted source view; proof type/perspective/provenance/authorship remain distinct; selected uses have individual reasons.

functional_flow: Parallel AI and frozen per-activity manifests
handling: Independent run rows; immutable input/output and ordered source links; reject out-of-manifest references.

functional_flow: Rubric definitions and independent label activation
handling: Axes, levels and conditions retain distinct meanings; root and step snapshots validate as one version package.

functional_flow: Period result selection and calculation
handling: Human observations distinct from period results; exact eligible/included/excluded sets, policy, explanation and approvals.

functional_flow: Inherited result and not-assessed display
handling: Reference eligible prior result; null level for not assessed; 50% exists only as display treatment.

functional_flow: Portfolio drafting, review and published fallback
handling: Working and published pointers reference different immutable content; freeze actual output, not just hashes or live IDs.

functional_flow: Student-edited six learner fields and authorship
handling: Explicit six columns; preserve generated/student/teacher/approved field revisions; student edits cannot modify observations.

functional_flow: System-selected sections, project and image request
handling: Typed cards preserve source IDs, type, selection reason/policy; image-request row records requested teacher and resulting association.

functional_flow: Invalidation and affected issued outputs
handling: Traverse source-to-dependent edges; flag stale, withdraw or approve successor; no silent recalculation.

functional_flow: Unassigned or overdue reviews and no approved output
handling: Owned queue work with due, escalation and resolution fields; no separate escalation-definition tables.

functional_flow: Exports and unavailable sources
handling: Export request pins approved snapshot and artifact reference; unavailable sources keep provenance.

functional_flow: Security and retention deferral
handling: 18 is the domain-table count, not the entire production database. Session/token, storage/queue and retention implementation are not designed or removed here.
